items.text: We have serious issues we need to address that impact Utah, including COVID-19, fentanyl, access to rural healthcare, and more. We need to work on what Americans need right now instead of making our fiscal problems even worse for future generations.

🎶All we are saying is give SLEEP a chance🎶

Time to turn forward the clocks once again! Don't forget the clock on the microwave and stovetop.

We must address the healthcare workforce shortage the country is facing & I am encouraged to see this package include my bipartisan legislation, the HEALS Act, which would provide funding for programs that educate and train mental and behavioral health care professionals.

Working with @RepCohen, we are making it abundantly clear that Russian oligarchs have no place to hide. 

Today we wrote to @POTUS and @SecBlinken  recommending sanctions for the Insurance Agency of Russia for its actions protecting oligarchs and targeting Kremlin opponents. https://t.co/0A87QMwBts
Just two months ago, the FDA received a $102 million budget increase, including $11 million specifically for maternal and infant health and nutrition.

Tomorrow, I am speaking with Taiwan's @bikhim at @RepChrisStewart Security Summit. 

Recent events show the importance of America’s partnership with Taiwan. I have long called for fair treatment of Taiwan internationally and deeper ties between our democracies.

My best to @MarcHarrisonMD. I have appreciated the relationship we have fostered working together to improve the lives of Utahns and I wish him the best as he transitions to this new opportunity. https://t.co/mdmqAVYjNx

I am ecstatic that my bill, the TAIPEI Act, opened the door for the U.S. to strengthen our ties with Taiwan. Happy #WomensHistoryMonth! The Utah legislature voted in 2018 to send a statue of Martha Hughes Cannon to the U.S. Capitol Building. 

Dr. Cannon was a trailblazer as an ardent suffragist, skilled physician, public health reformer, and the first female state senator in the U.S. https://t.co/kcC23w3wgv

Last week, Team Curtis participated in the grand opening of the new VA clinic in Price. The new and improved facility provides advanced telemedicine capabilities and dedicated exam rooms for women's health for veterans from Spanish Fork to Moab. https://t.co/P35PtriQ5B

Congress is acting to address CCP influence in international organizations. Last Wednesday, the House Foreign Affairs Committee passed my bill, the Taiwan International Solidarity Act, unanimously. It combats China’s attempts to claim sovereignty over Taiwan in international organizations.

Our hearts go out to Draper, Mayor Walker, and all who are dealing with flooding. Those of you who had damage, we're here for you and we'll do all we can to help. 

Please follow local authorities for updates and exercise caution driving or walking through flooded areas.

Proud to have supported the passage of this bill and  help deploy new technologies to combat the widespread damage these fires cause to our communities, our health, and our environment.

Great meeting with the team at Donor Connect this week. We delved into how organ procurement organizations are evaluated in the US and the vital role they play in Utah, serving 3.9M residents, 90+ hospitals, 3 transplant centers, and the Wahlen VA Medical Center. https://t.co/OXDoWcLsdZ

Gilsonite is a mineral unique to the Uintah Basin. Utah mines this product responsibly and it should be protected against imposters. By updating the Mineral Leasing Act, this unique Utah product can exercise their trademark and void the market of foreign imposters.

I am grateful for the support of @RepBurgessOwens, @RepMaloyUtah, and @RepBlakeMoore on this critical legislation.

As I spell out in my DEFUND Act, the UN is a largely wasteful organization with many agencies the US shouldn’t be funding. The Security Council is one of the few areas where a presence is in our national interest, from which we can prevent unjust treatment against our friends and allies. 

Today’s move by the Biden Administration, allowing a resolution to pass with no mention of the civilian hostages, is inexcusable. This action caves to the demands of China and Russia, who bizarrely sit on the UN Security Council despite their open hostility to foreign nations.

It is clear the UN needs serious reforms and the Biden Admin must reverse course. #utpol

For decades and decades, people have sacrificed sometimes safety, sometimes health so that the rest of us could flip a switch and get electricity.

It’s not everyday you get to see the machine that powered homes across Utah and I was pleased to join in Emery County to dedicate a steam turbine this week. https://t.co/4SZnvMSZTJ

Thank you @RepBurgessOwens: From water districts to Washington, DC, we need every tool in the toolbox to protect the long-term health of the Great Salt Lake for generations to come. The Great Salt Lake Stewardship Act allocates financial resources for drought mitigation, employs innovative approaches to water conservation, and helps replenish the lake's water levels. I am proud to join the Utah delegation in continuing to bolster local efforts to preserve and maintain our state's precious water resources.

Thank you @RepMaloyUtah: The Great Salt Lake is integral to Utah’s economy and the health of the surrounding region. Preserving it will require partnerships with state and local leaders. I’m proud to work with my Utah colleagues on legislation that will support local, water conservation efforts focused on replenishing the lake.

I’m always amazed by the innovative ways Utah's farmers and ranchers manage crops and livestock.

At McMurdie Farm, I saw how AMP Grazing improves soil health, retains water, and saves farmers money. Healthy soil, less water wasted, and more money saved—an approach worth celebrating! #utpol
7/ The Colorado River is the lifeblood of the West—its health is vital for our communities, economy, and environment. This is a significant step forward for water users across the Basin.

I'm pleased that my bill, the Recognizing the Importance of Critical Minerals in Healthcare Act, passed the House yesterday. This ensures HHS is involved in critical mineral decisions, protecting key healthcare technologies like MRIs. https://t.co/UkhKSC6bdT
